text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unprecedented fervor sweeps the<n>Tokyo
Racecourse as Grass Wonder,<n>El Condor Pasa, and
Silence Suzuka<n>all gather for a single race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle once again joins<n>Reporter Etsuko
Otonashi as a<n>spectator.

As the crowd eagerly looks on,<n>Silence Suzuka
instantly breaks away<n>from the pack, picking up
even more<n>speed on the final stretch to claim
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her unique style of running captivates<n>the hearts of
those who witness it.
